title: Manager of Construction Loan Servicing
description:
Manager of Construction Loan Servicing
Location: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Employment Type: Full-Time (Onsite)

Ideal Candidate
Must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Mortgage Banking, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Must have 7+ years of experience in Construction Loan Servicing, Mortgage Servicing, Construction Lending, Loan Administration, or Mortgage Operations.
Must have strong experience managing the entire construction loan lifecycle, including builder approval, draw administration, inspections, loan balancing, and construction-to-permanent loan conversions.
Must have experience managing construction draw schedules, inspection processes, loan disbursements, and construction servicing operations.
Must have experience working with Construction Loans, Renovation Loans, Portfolio Loans, or Held-for-Sale Mortgage Loans.
Must possess strong knowledge of construction lending regulations, mortgage servicing operations, SOX controls, audits, compliance, GL reconciliations, and risk management.
Must have experience leading process improvements, developing policies and procedures, KPI/KRI reporting, and operational efficiencies.
Strong leadership, communication, analytical, organizational, and project management skills are required.
Mortgage banking or financial services experience is highly preferred.

The Manager of Construction Loan Servicing will oversee all operational activities related to construction and renovation loan servicing, from builder approval through final loan conversion.
This position is responsible for managing construction draw administration, inspections, servicing operations, audit compliance, risk management, policy development, staff training, and operational performance while ensuring regulatory compliance and exceptional customer service.
The successful candidate will collaborate with Mortgage Servicing, Construction Lending, Secondary Marketing, Sales, Compliance, and Executive Leadership to improve operational efficiency and minimize risk throughout the construction loan servicing process.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the complete construction loan servicing lifecycle from builder approval through loan conversion.
Oversee construction draw schedules, inspections, disbursements, and loan balancing.
Manage construction platform vendors and servicing operations.
Ensure construction projects are completed within required timelines.
Monitor construction loan portfolios and held-for-sale pipelines.
Review aged loans and ensure loan salability.
Ensure compliance with construction lending regulations and servicing policies.
Manage SOX controls, audits, compliance reviews, and risk mitigation.
Oversee general ledger reconciliations, DDA accounts, and year-end tax reporting.
Develop and update policies, procedures, and operational standards.
Drive process improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies.
Establish KPI/KRI reporting and performance metrics.
Train, coach, mentor, and develop construction servicing staff.
Collaborate with Sales, Secondary Marketing, Compliance, and Executive Leadership.
Ensure proper staffing, onboarding, performance management, and employee development.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
Minimum 7 years of Construction Loan Servicing or Mortgage Servicing experience.

Experience managing:
Construction Loans
Construction Draw Administration
Builder Approval Process
Inspection Administration
Loan Conversion
Construction-to-Permanent Loans

Experience with:
Construction Lending
Mortgage Operations
Loan Servicing
Risk Management
SOX Controls
Audit & Compliance
GL Reconciliations
KPI/KRI Reporting

Strong knowledge of:
Mortgage Servicing
Construction Lending
Regulatory Compliance
Operational Controls

Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and organizational skills.
Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System (NMLS) registration or willingness to obtain.
Experience with renovation lending.
Portfolio and held-for-sale mortgage servicing.
Construction loan servicing platforms.
Banking or Financial Services industry experience.
Process improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
Staff leadership, coaching, and mentoring experience.

title: Associate Director Manufacturing
description:
Associate Director Manufacturing
Location: Sumter, South Carolina
Employment Type: Full-Time

Ideal Candidate
Must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related discipline.
Must have 15+ years of manufacturing experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
Must have 5+ years of Operations Management experience leading manufacturing operations.
Must have 5+ years of cross-functional leadership experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • Quality
  • Engineering
  • Supply Chain
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Finance
Must have proven experience leading manufacturing operations, driving Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost (SQDC) performance, and implementing operational excellence initiatives.
Must possess strong experience with Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, Operational Excellence, OEE Improvement, Asset Reliability, Cost Reduction, and Manufacturing Performance Improvement.
Must have experience leading large cross-functional teams while managing budgets, P&L, manufacturing KPIs, and strategic operational initiatives.
Experience in Medical Device, FDA-regulated, GMP, ISO, or highly regulated manufacturing is highly preferred.
Experience with Injection Molding, High-Speed Automated Manufacturing, Rubber Compounding, or Part Forming is highly desirable.

This role will lead manufacturing teams, oversee production performance, establish operational strategies, develop budgets, improve manufacturing capability, and partner with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Human Resources, and R&D to achieve world-class manufacturing performance.
The successful candidate will champion Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and Operational Excellence while developing high-performing teams and ensuring regulatory compliance within a highly regulated manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities
Lead manufacturing operations and plant performance.
Develop and execute manufacturing strategies aligned with business objectives.
Drive Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) improvements.
Lead Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
Improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), asset reliability, and manufacturing efficiency.
Optimize manufacturing costs and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).
Develop annual operating budgets and monitor financial performance.
Drive operational excellence using production systems and Lean methodologies.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Marketing, and R&D.
Ensure compliance with GMP, ISO, OSHA, CFR, and company quality systems.
Build and develop high-performing manufacturing leadership teams.
Drive talent development, coaching, succession planning, and employee engagement.
Support capital investments, process improvements, and manufacturing modernization.
Promote a culture of safety, accountability, diversity, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or related discipline.
Minimum 15 years of Manufacturing experience.
Minimum 5 years of Manufacturing Operations Management experience.
Minimum 5 years of Cross-Functional leadership experience in Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Continuous Improvement, or Finance.

title: Senior Project Manager - Commercial Construction
description:
Senior Project Manager
Location: Tulsa, Oklahoma
Employment Type: Full-Time

Ideal Candidate
Must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent construction management experience may be considered.
Must have 10+ years of commercial construction project management experience working directly for a medium to large commercial General Contractor.
Must have extensive experience managing large, complex commercial construction projects from preconstruction through final closeout.
Must have strong experience in Project Management, Financial Management, Budgeting, Cost Forecasting, Change Orders, Risk Management, Scheduling, Procurement, and Contract Administration.
Must have experience leading Owner, Architect, Contractor (OAC) meetings while coordinating subcontractors, consultants, vendors, field operations, and project teams.
Must possess strong experience in Preconstruction, GMP development, Estimating, Bid Analysis, Buyout, Scope Review, and Business Development.
Must have demonstrated success managing project profitability, developing project teams, and building long-term client relationships.
Experience with CMiC, BIM, Scheduling Software, Lean Construction, and Commercial Project Controls is highly preferred.

The Senior Project Manager provides overall leadership and accountability for complex commercial construction projects from preconstruction through project completion.
This role is responsible for project execution, financial performance, scheduling, safety, quality, procurement, subcontractor management, client relationships, and overall project profitability. The successful candidate will lead project teams while collaborating with operations, estimating, preconstruction, field leadership, and executive management to ensure successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Lead commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.
Manage project financial performance, budgets, forecasting, and profitability.
Develop and execute project business plans.
Lead project safety initiatives and maintain an injury-free culture.
Manage preconstruction activities including estimating, GMP development, scope review, and bid analysis.
Lead subcontractor buyout, procurement, and contract administration.
Coordinate Owners, Architects, Engineers, Consultants, Vendors, and Field Teams.
Lead OAC meetings, progress meetings, and executive project reviews.
Manage project schedules and identify schedule risks and mitigation plans.
Prepare change orders, negotiate pricing, and manage contingency budgets.
Oversee project documentation, QA/QC, and project compliance.
Monitor project costs, margins, productivity, and financial reporting.
Lead project closeout including punch lists, warranties, financial reconciliation, and turnover.
Support business development and marketing initiatives.
Mentor Project Engineers, Assistant Project Managers, and Project Managers.
Foster Lean Construction, collaboration, diversity, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
Minimum 10 years of Commercial Construction Project Management experience.
Experience working directly for a medium to large Commercial General Contractor.

Strong experience with:
Project Management
Financial Management
Cost Forecasting
Budget Management
Business Development
Risk Management
Contract Administration
Scheduling
Procurement

Experience with:
Preconstruction
GMP Development
Estimating
Bid Analysis
Buyout
Change Orders

Experience leading Owners, Architects, Engineers, and Subcontractors.
Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
Valid unrestricted Driver's License.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with CMiC.
BIM (Building Information Modeling).
Lean Construction methodologies.
Commercial Building Construction.
Healthcare, Industrial, Manufacturing, Aviation, Federal, or Large Commercial project experience.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong client relationship and business development experience.
Advanced scheduling software experience (Primavera P6, MS Project, etc.).
